title: Gray Subway Backsplash with Metallic Accent Bands
summary: Kitchen backsplash installation combining gray subway tile with horizontal metallic mosaic accent bands beneath detailed white cabinetry.
problem: The kitchen needed a backsplash design that would protect the wall while adding a decorative feature beneath the upper cabinets.
solution: Installed gray subway tile with two aligned metallic mosaic accent bands, maintaining straight layout lines around outlets, corners and cabinetry details.
